author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In the workshop of master blacksmith Tony Swatton, Adam picks up and examines a pair of beautiful daggers inspired by the Daedric weapons from the Elder Scrolls video game series! Tony explains how these prototypes were made to give them their distinctive dark chrome finish, and then brings out two more hero prop knives to compare aluminum and steel constructions. 

Find Tony Swatton's builds at https://thetonyswatton.com/ and subscribe to his new channel at https://www.youtube.com/@TheTonySwatton 

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
